answer: A tree surgeon climbs with a harness and a survey sheet. The sheet lists the trunk, the crown, the rot, the date. Proof of arborist certification via international tree care association reads like that sheet: a certification the tree care association has renewed after field exams. One invented survey costs a pencil. A hundred invented surveys cost a hundred climbs, a hundred trees the surveyor never touched, and the jetty of each is the sawdust on his boots — the cipher is the client who watched him climb, the zephyr the ladder he left leaning on the fence.
